dave: @lobu who owns the Globex account these days?

input.text:
Hey @dave — I don't have a way to look up account ownership from here. I can't query the CRM data directly.

Could you check the account record in the app (the Globex account page shows the assigned owner), or tell me where that data lives so I can point you at the right place? I don't want to guess at ownership since that's easy to get wrong.
